title: The Missing Page
scene: At 6:15 PM, a rare manuscript page was torn out. The library's old lift was stuck from 6:00 to 6:30.

suspects.name: Arthur Vale
suspects.testimony: I was trapped in the lift at 6:15, waiting for help.
suspects.contradiction: The lift was stuck empty on floor three, and the torn page was in Arthur's coat.

suspects.name: Bina Rao
suspects.testimony: I was in the reading room at 6:15, helping a visitor.
suspects.alibiProof: The reading room sign-in shows Bina's visitor at 6:11 and 6:22.

suspects.name: Cedric Hale
suspects.testimony: I was watching the front door at 6:15.
suspects.alibiProof: The door camera logs Cedric's badge at 6:14 and 6:28.

suspects.name: Dora Pike
suspects.testimony: I was sorting donations in the basement at 6:15.
suspects.alibiProof: The donation cart log shows Dora's cart at 6:12 and 6:25.
